commit_message:
[GPU] Fix integer reduction identities at the element bit width

Build signed extrema and all-ones integer reduction identities with APInt
at the element width. Separate signed and unsigned min/max identities and
use all ones for AND. Keep floating-point cases and index attribute storage
width unchanged.

Extend the existing common and AMD wide-shuffle tests to check the
identity used by each reduction across i8/i16/i32/i64.

Fixes #25153.

Bump cpp-linter/cpp-linter-action from 2.23.1 to 2.24.0 in the github-actions group (#25175) Bumps the github-actions group with 1 update: [cpp-linter/cpp-linter-action](https://github.com/cpp-linter/cpp-linter-action). Updates `cpp-linter/cpp-linter-action` from 2.23.1 to 2.24.0
Release notes

Sourced from cpp-linter/cpp-linter-action's releases.

v2.24.0

Behavior changes

  • ignore: build now only skips build/ at the repo root. Earlier versions also skipped nested folders such as src/build/, which was a bug. To skip every build folder, use ignore: '**/build'.
  • A relative database path is now resolved against the workspace (the working directory), not against repo-root. repo-root must be inside the workspace.
  • When the action downloads clang-format or clang-tidy (on Windows, or when the runner doesn't have the requested version), it now gets the newest patch release of that major version (for example, 14.0.6 instead of 14.0.0), together with clang's resource headers.

Improvements

  • windows-11-arm runners work now: cpp-linter no longer depends on pygit2, which has no Windows arm64 wheel.
  • A repo-root that is a sub-folder of the git repository works now.
  • Comments and reviews are posted through git-bot-feedback, which fixes the API URLs on GitHub Enterprise Server.

🐛 Bug fixes

  • fix: pass action inputs to run steps through env by @​shenxianpeng in #508

📝 Documentation updates

  • docs: add Google Analytics and a descriptive home page title by @​shenxianpeng in #504
  • docs: add a Sponsors section to the README by @​shenxianpeng in #497
  • docs: rework the README to the org layout and move required tools to the docs by @​shenxianpeng in #493
  • docs: drop the note that thread comments are disabled on private repositories by @​shenxianpeng in #492
  • docs: fix the usage example and the list of users by @​shenxianpeng in #491
  • docs: let the shared styles bring the fonts by @​shenxianpeng in #489
  • docs: load the shared styles and rename the hub link by @​shenxianpeng in #487

👻 Maintenance

  • chore: update filelock to 4.2.4 for its security fixes by @​shenxianpeng in #514
  • chore: limit workflow token permissions by @​shenxianpeng in #507
  • chore: add a repo-level FUNDING.yml by @​shenxianpeng in #498
